description: Enable tasks to declare output variables that are captured at completion and made available to downstream tasks via the existing ${{ }} template syntax.

tasks.title: Add task output definition schema
tasks.description: Add TaskOutputDefinition record and optional Outputs property to TaskDefinition so workflow definitions can declare runtime output variables with name and from selector.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskOutputDefinition record exists with Name and From properties
TaskDefinition has optional Outputs list
Tasks without Outputs behave identically to before
tasks.output: Updated TaskDefinition model with Outputs support

tasks.title: Parse and validate outputs in workflow YAML
tasks.description: Update the workflow YAML parser and validator to accept the optional outputs array, reject entries missing name or from, and reject duplicate output names within a task.
acceptanceCriteria: YAML with outputs array parses correctly
Missing name or from is rejected
Duplicate output names in same task are rejected
Omitted outputs is valid
tasks.output: Updated YAML parser/validator with output validation tests

tasks.title: Extend WorkResult with captured outputs
tasks.description: Add an optional CapturedOutputs dictionary to the runner-to-server WorkResult contract so runners can report extracted task output variables.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkResult has optional CapturedOutputs field
Older runners without the field are tolerated
Serialization round-trips correctly
tasks.notes: Server-side contract change; field is optional for backward compatibility.

tasks.title: Add runtime variable store to WorkflowRun
tasks.description: Add a runtime variable store to the WorkflowRun aggregate state and a domain method to append captured outputs transactionally on successful task completion.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowRun state includes runtime variable store
Store initializes empty
Domain method appends outputs under tasks.<id>.outputs.<name>
Failed results do not modify the store
tasks.output: Updated WorkflowRun aggregate with runtime store

tasks.title: Capture declared outputs in runner
tasks.description: Update the runner to parse ActionResult.output as JSON, extract declared outputs using from selectors on successful task completion, and include them in WorkResult.CapturedOutputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful tasks with declared outputs populate CapturedOutputs
Failed tasks produce no CapturedOutputs
Missing from fields are skipped without failure
Only declared outputs are captured
tasks.output: Updated runner output capture logic and tests

tasks.title: Store captured outputs in workflow engine
tasks.description: Update WorkflowGrain.ProcessTaskResultAsync to look up the current task definition, validate reported output names match declared names, and store them in the WorkflowRun runtime variable store on success.
acceptanceCriteria: Successful WorkResult with CapturedOutputs stores variables
Only outputs declared in task definition are stored
Failed task results do not store outputs
Store keys use tasks.<id>.outputs.<name>

tasks.title: Merge runtime variables into dispatch resolution
tasks.description: Update WorkflowGrain.MakeDispatchAsync to deep-merge the WorkflowRun runtime variable store into the dispatch variable resolution chain after dispatch injection and before final template rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime variables are included in resolved vars
Runtime vars take precedence over lower-precedence sources
Empty runtime store produces unchanged behavior
tasks.<id>.outputs.<name> is resolvable in templates
tasks.output: Updated MakeDispatchAsync with runtime variable merge

tasks.title: Verify template resolution for task outputs
tasks.description: Add tests verifying that ${{ tasks.<id>.outputs.<name> }} resolves correctly in task with and artifacts, missing outputs resolve to empty, and existing template behavior is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: ${{ tasks.id.outputs.name }} resolves in with values
${{ tasks.id.outputs.name }} resolves in artifact paths
Missing runtime outputs resolve to empty
Existing ${{ }} resolution remains unchanged
tasks.notes: May be covered by existing template engine if vars are injected correctly; add explicit tests.

tasks.title: End-to-end integration test for task output variables
tasks.description: Add an integration test that runs a workflow where one task declares outputs and a downstream task references them via ${{ tasks.<id>.outputs.<name> }}, verifying capture, persistence, and resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test exercises full output capture flow
Downstream task receives captured output value
Failed task produces no outputs
Test passes
